expiry capabilities. It includes a thread-safe wrapper using locks and a comprehensive
test suite using pytest.

1. LRU Eviction: When the cache reaches its maximum capacity, the least recently
   used item is evicted to make room for new items.

   expires, the item is considered invalid and will be evicted on the next access
   or during periodic cleanup.

   safe concurrent access from multiple threads.

   be cleaned up eagerly via a background task or explicit method.
